args.brief: Chapter 3 "The Duplicate": Nadi reads the handling note, then asks Sol about the missing second page of the flight register. Sol supplies a duplicate page that arrives in a plain envelope, with no stamp, seal or return address; Nadi and Wren examine it on the work table with clean dry hands, without opening the wooden sleeve. They compare its entries against the label and the handling note, record what the envelope contained in writing, and agree to finish the checking before the public demonstration. Quiet, precise practical actions; no injuries; sleeve stays intact and closed. Third-person past tense, centred on Nadi.
